description: Clinical trials from ClinicalTrials.gov by condition, drug or device, sponsor, site location, status, phase and sponsor type: dates, enrollment, design, interventions, eligibility, outcomes, central contacts (name, phone, email) and study sites. Use for trial landscapes, site and patient recruitment, competitive intelligence and new-study alerts. Runs the Apify Actor tacps126/clinical-trials on your Apify account (about $0.003 per study; spend per call is capped at $0.5).

extra_input.description: Advanced: extra Actor input fields, merged over the defaults.

first_posted_within_days.description: Only studies first posted in the last N days.

keywords.description: Words anywhere in the study record.

location.description: Country, state or city of a site, e.g. "India", "Boston".

max_items.description: Maximum results to return (default 50, max 1000). Cost scales with this.

name: search_clinical_trials

count.description: Number of records the Actor returned.

items.description: The records. Long text fields are shortened to 600 characters.

shown.description: Number of records included in `items` (can be lower than count when the result is long).

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced the result.

truncated.description: True when records were left out to keep the result short; ask for fewer items.

title: Search clinical trials (ClinicalTrials.gov)
